Supplied guide incorrectly defines extinct by a50-year absence and confuses extinction in the wild;corrected.
Supplied key assumes solubility halves with Celsius temperature,which is unsupported.
Supplied key defines insoluble as able to dissolve—the opposite;corrected.
All listed actions can involve force;not uniquely single-answer as phrased.
Forces determine acceleration,not necessarily current direction of motion without initial conditions.
Supplied text wrongly says200g has10N more while its own values show less;corrected.

Pie charts can also represent categorical preferences,so the item is not uniquely answered as phrased.
